payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all substrings of a and b via double loops, map each to deletion counts from ends, then find minimal total deletions for any common substring.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a complete search over all possible final substrings after deletions. It uses nested loops to generate all contiguous substrings, not recursion or decision trees. Among the given complete_search subtypes, none perfectly fit substring enumeration, but backtracking is the most generic exhaustive search subtype available.
